items.title: Realizing a profinite space as the connected components of an ind-Zariski cover
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring A and a continuous map from a profinite space T to the space of connected components of Spec(A) there is an ind-Zariski ring map A -> B whose spectrum is the fibre product of Spec(A) with T over the components, with T the space of connected components of Spec(B) (statement lines 1097-1110). The proof (proof lines 1112-1139) writes T as a limit of finite discrete spaces, realizes each closed piece by an ind-Zariski quotient via the construction lemma, and passes to the colimit. H2: a three-step construction with four inputs, written out in full.
